headline: H100 SXM and H200 indexes fell -11% over 7 days while B200 rose +3%.
bullets: H100 SXM's market index is $5.50, down -11% over 7 days, with a +158% hyperscaler premium ($10.68 vs $4.14 neocloud), the widest of any GPU tracked.
H200's index also fell -11% to $6.15, and its marketplace median of $3.77 sits well below the $5.65 neocloud median.
B200 is the only GPU trending up, +3% to an index of $8.60, with a hyperscaler premium of +77% ($14.12 vs $7.99).
MI300X offers the best price-performance at $2.64 per PFLOP-hour on a $3.45 index, though only 5 providers list it and RunPod Community Cloud's median is $0.50.
A100 80GB SXM ($2.70) and L40S ($1.50) were flat at +0%, but A100 is the costliest per unit of compute at $8.65 per PFLOP-hour.
watch: Whether the -11% slide in H100 SXM and H200 extends, and whether hyperscaler medians of $10.68 and $10.30 follow neocloud and marketplace pricing down.
